'''Tomasz Dietl''' (born 1 October 1950) is a Polish [[physicist]]; [[professor]] and head of the Laboratory for Cryogenic and Spintronic Research at the Institute of Physics, [[Polish Academy of Sciences]]; and professor of the Institute of Theoretical Physics at the [[University of Warsaw]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.ifpan.edu.pl/SL-2/dietl.html|title=IP PAS - International Centre for Interfacing Magnetism and Superconductivity with Topological Matter – MagTop (ON-6)}}</ref> 

His research interests include [[semiconductors]], [[spintronics]], and [[nanotechnology]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://wpolityce.pl/polityka/127024-sukces-i-nadzieja-polskiej-nauki-prof-tomasz-dietl-we-wladzach-europejskiej-rady-ds-badan-naukowych |language=pl |title=Sukces i nadzieja polskiej nauki! Prof. Tomasz Dietl we władzach Europejskiej Rady ds. Badań Naukowych |website=wpolityce.pl |access-date=2 February 2023}}</ref> With over 20,000 citations, he is considered a leading Polish physicist.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.naukawpolsce.pap.pl/aktualnosci/news,388088,polski-fizyk-we-wladzach-organizacji-european-research-council.html|title = Polski fizyk we władzach organizacji European Research Council| newspaper=Nauka W Polsce }}</ref>

==Career==
He graduated from the University of Warsaw at the age of 23 (master's degree) and subsequently obtained his PhD from the Polish Academy of Sciences in 1977. He obtained a [[habilitation]] in 1983 and the title of [[professor]] in 1990.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.ifpan.edu.pl/SL-2/dietlcv.html |title=Tomasz Dietl Tomasz Dietl - Curriculum Vitae |access-date=7 March 2020}}</ref> Since then he has been working in the Institute of Physics of the Polish Academy of Sciences. In 2009, he became a member of the [[Polish Academy of Learning]] (PAU) as well as the [[Warsaw Scientific Society]] (WTN).<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.instytucja.pan.pl/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=1433:dietl-tomasz&catid=50:wydzia-iii&Itemid=30 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160128194531/http://www.instytucja.pan.pl/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=1433:dietl-tomasz&catid=50:wydzia-iii&Itemid=30 |url-status=dead |archive-date=28 January 2016 |title=DIETL, Tomasz |access-date=7 March 2020}}</ref> He worked as a [[visiting professor]] at the [[Johannes Kepler University Linz]] (1991–92, 1996–98), [[Joseph Fourier University]] (1993-2000) and [[Tohoku University]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.fnp.org.pl/prof-dr-hab-tomasz-dietl-laureat-nagrody-fnp-2006/ |title=PROF. DR HAB. TOMASZ DIETL – LAUREAT NAGRODY FNP 2006 |access-date=7 March 2020}}</ref>

In 2006, he received Poland's top science award, the [[Prize of the Foundation for Polish Science]], "for developing the theory, confirmed in recent years, of diluted [[ferromagnetic]] [[semiconductor]]s, and for demonstrating new methods in controlling [[magnetization]]."<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.fnp.org.pl/prof-dr-hab-tomasz-dietl-laureat-nagrody-fnp-2006/ |title=PROF. DR HAB. TOMASZ DIETL – LAUREAT NAGRODY FNP 2006 |access-date=7 March 2020}}</ref>

==Personal life==

He is the son of economist [[Jerzy Dietl]]. He is married and has two children.

==Honours and awards==
* Gold [[Cross of Merit (Poland)|Cross of Merit]] (1990)<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.instytucja.pan.pl/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=1433:dietl-tomasz&catid=50:wydzia-iii&Itemid=30 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160128194531/http://www.instytucja.pan.pl/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=1433:dietl-tomasz&catid=50:wydzia-iii&Itemid=30 |url-status=dead |archive-date=28 January 2016 |title=DIETL, Tomasz |access-date=7 March 2020}}</ref> 
* Maria Skłodowska-Curie Award of the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]] (1997)
* [[Alexander von Humboldt Research Award]] (2003)
* Fellow of the [[Institute of Physics]], UK (2004)
* [[Europhysics Prize]] (with [[Hideo Ohno]] and [[David Awschalom]]), [[European Physical Society]] (2005)
* [[Prize of the Foundation for Polish Science]] (2006)
* [[Marian Smoluchowski Medal]] of the [[Polish Physical Society]] (2010)
* Member of [[Academia Europaea]] (2011)
* Commander's Cross of the [[Order of Polonia Restituta]], (2013)<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.prezydent.pl/aktualnosci/ordery-i-odznaczenia/art,1208,odznaczenia-z-okazji-swieta-narodowego-3-maja.html |archive-url=https://archive.today/20130705193014/http://www.prezydent.pl/aktualnosci/ordery-i-odznaczenia/art,1208,odznaczenia-z-okazji-swieta-narodowego-3-maja.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=5 July 2013 |title=Odznaczenia z okazji Święta Narodowego 3 Maja |access-date=7 March 2020}}</ref>
* Fellow of the [[American Physical Society]] (2015)
* [[Tohoku University International Award - Special Award]] (2025)
